data.name: Mask of the Wild
desc: You can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

provenance.source_document: docs/暫用規則資訊/種族_PHB_非SRD內容.md

data.name: Superior Darkvision
desc: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

provenance.source_document: docs/暫用規則資訊/種族_PHB_非SRD內容.md

data.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
desc: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you or the target is in direct sunlight.

provenance.source_document: docs/暫用規則資訊/種族_PHB_非SRD內容.md

data.name: Drow Magic
desc: You know Dancing Lights. At character level 3 you can cast Faerie Fire once per long rest, and at level 5 Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

provenance.source_document: docs/暫用規則資訊/種族_PHB_非SRD內容.md

data.name: Stout Resilience
desc: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

provenance.source_document: docs/暫用規則資訊/種族_PHB_非SRD內容.md

data.name: Natural Illusionist
desc: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

data.name: Speak with Small Beasts
desc: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.
